notes: All 8 planned kinds kept (old k84–k91). Nothing dropped from the old data and no moves. Bar soap is now variety-style: 13 archetypes, with the traditions first (Aleppo, Nabulsi, Marseille, African black soap, Moroccan savon beldi), then branded icons in date order (Pears 1807 … Dr. Bronner's 1948). Savon beldi sits under Bar soap even though it is a soft paste, because it belongs to the hammam soap tradition. Lush's claim to the bath bomb is confirmed by both Wikipedia and Lush, so it is recorded as the originator archetype. Nabulsi and Aleppo UNESCO ICH listings (Dec 2024) are confirmed by Wikipedia and premiumbeautynews. Left out: no individual SKUs for the deodorant brands, because I could not confirm model names (Rexona Motionsense etc.) on any page I retrieved. Ranges are given instead and the two old models are kept. No independent test winner (Which?/CR) was retrieved for deodorants; an NBC Select test page was retrieved but its winners could not be extracted. Dr Teal's has no brand entry because its page was blocked. Wet-wipe brands (Huggies, Pampers, WaterWipes) are not added because their pages were not retrieved; the Femfresh intimate wipes are kept from the old data. Peştemal (hammam cloth) is mentioned in the tradition entry only, since it is a towel and probably belongs in Home textiles. Not retrieved, so not added: sea-sponge species and Korean/Japanese bath brands beyond MUJI. Marseille makers appear as versions without register entries, because only the UPSM page was retrieved for them.
